description: Hi! I'm Chaîmae, a physics graduate with 2 years of experience teaching math. I love space education and explaining science simply. Our team is working on "Abandoned but not Forgotten": telling the stories of NASA's hardware left on the Moon and Mars for school-age learners. Looking for teammates for illustration/design, digital storytelling (book, video or podcast) or a simple website. No expert level needed, just curiosity. We will work online.
